final: WITH a AS (SELECT ac.account_id, c.town_city AS town, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Financial_Transactions ft WHERE ft.account_id = ac.account_id) AS n FROM Accounts ac JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ac.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> ''), t AS (SELECT a.*, SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS town_total, AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_n FROM a) SELECT account_id, town, n AS transaction_count, CASE WHEN town_total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE n * 1.0 / town_total END AS share_of_town, n / avg_n AS ratio_to_avg FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
